SELECT DISTINCT(CITD.NAME) AS `LABEL`, CITD.NAME AS `VALUE`, CITD.LOGIC_DEL AS `DISABLED` FROM common_icon_template_header CITH LEFT JOIN common_icon_template_detail CITD ON CITH.ID = CITD.HEADER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CITH.USER_ID = #{userId} AND CITD.ICON_TREE_TYPE = 'L'
